rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides AI assistants with access to Authentik's identity and access management platform through both full-featured and diagnostic-only variants, built by Authentik Security Inc. using Python and Node.js implementations. The server offers comprehensive user, group, and application management capabilities alongside event monitoring, authentication flow configuration, and system administration tools, with the diagnostic variant providing read-only monitoring for production environments. Built with the Model Context Protocol SDK and featuring extensive API coverage including CRUD operations for users/groups, application lifecycle management, audit log analysis, and provider configuration, it serves organizations needing AI-driven identity management automation, security teams requiring programmatic access to authentication analytics, and developers building identity-aware applications that integrate with Authentik's enterprise authentication platform.
